title: Prompt injection text exists only as a test fixture
symptom: A repository contains hostile-looking instruction text inside a test fixture that is never consumed as runtime instruction.
expected_behavior: The Hospital records suspicious content but does not diagnose compromise without causal reachability and behavioral impact.
control_under_test: Instruction-like text must remain evidence rather than automatic proof of compromise.
required_observations: Provenance must identify the material as a fixture.
Reachability to the active instruction path must be tested.
prohibited_conclusions: Prompt injection is confirmed solely because hostile text exists.
